description: CLK1 (2m, the wanted signal is the fundamental) through two identical cheap band-pass filters marked 137M/140M in series, and a measured 37 dB pad set

chain.name: LC band-pass 137M/140M, first
chain.notes: L-C-L-C-L in series with capacitors to ground at each junction; the same one as in the single-filter baseline

chain.name: LC band-pass 137M/140M, second
chain.notes: identical to the first, connected directly after it

chain.name: pad set
chain.notes: measured, not the labels: the 27-33-27 ohm T pad (15 dB) in series with the BNC attenuator marked 10 dB (really 27 dB), joined with SMA/BNC adapters. Measured together without a filter on 2026-10-31 as 37.4 dB at 145 MHz (36.9 to 38.4 dB from 20 to 180 MHz).

notes: Compare with 2m-lc-bandpass-137-140MHz-37dB (one filter). Same pad set, so levels are comparable. The pad value was measured without any filter in front of it.
